hook: Congress just changed hands. Now what?
reel_hook: Congress flipped. And that's not all.

slides.title: Democrats win House and Senate
slides.image_prompt: The US Capitol dome at dawn under a sky split into deep blue and red clouds, empty steps in the foreground
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Democrats won both chambers, flipping 7+ Senate seats.
WHY IT MATTERS
Trump's last two years now face a Democratic Congress.
FOR YOU
Analysts expect gridlock from January 2027, so big new laws get harder.
slides.body: Democrats won both chambers, flipping 7+ Senate seats. Trump's last two years now face a Democratic Congress. Analysts expect gridlock from January 2027, so big new laws get harder.

slides.title: US strikes Iran's Qeshm Island
slides.image_prompt: Oil tanker crossing a narrow sea strait at dusk, a rocky island on the horizon with a distant smoke plume
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
The US carried out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island.
WHY IT MATTERS
It sits in Hormuz, a key route for world oil.
FOR YOU
Hormuz carried 20 million barrels of oil daily pre-war; tension can move fuel prices.
slides.body: The US carried out limited strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island. It sits in Hormuz, a key route for world oil. Hormuz carried 20 million barrels of oil daily pre-war; tension can move fuel prices.

slides.title: Ukraine talks set for Abu Dhabi
slides.image_prompt: Empty negotiating table with three chairs and water glasses in a bright room overlooking a desert city skyline
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Russia confirmed it will join US-mediated talks with Ukraine.
WHY IT MATTERS
Both sides will sit at one table, with the US in between.
FOR YOU
Watch Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November; Zelensky also wants the EU involved.
slides.body: Russia confirmed it will join US-mediated talks with Ukraine. Both sides will sit at one table, with the US in between. Watch Abu Dhabi on 10–11 November; Zelensky also wants the EU involved.

slides.title: Gaza ceasefire under strain
slides.image_prompt: An olive branch resting on cracked grey concrete under a hazy evening sky, soft warm light
slides.label: WORLD
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Israeli strikes killed at least five, Gaza health officials say.
WHY IT MATTERS
They test a US-brokered ceasefire from October 2025.
FOR YOU
The year-old truce still stands, but deadly incidents show how fragile it is.
slides.body: Israeli strikes killed at least five, Gaza health officials say. They test a US-brokered ceasefire from October 2025. The year-old truce still stands, but deadly incidents show how fragile it is.

slides.title: Georgia makes history
slides.image_prompt: Georgia state capitol gold dome glowing at sunrise, peach blossoms in the foreground
slides.label: POLITICS
points: WHAT HAPPENED
Keisha Lance Bottoms was elected governor of Georgia.
WHY IT MATTERS
She's the first Black woman elected governor of any state.
FOR YOU
A milestone: no US state had elected a Black woman governor before.
slides.body: Keisha Lance Bottoms was elected governor of Georgia. She's the first Black woman elected governor of any state. A milestone: no US state had elected a Black woman governor before.
